sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 7XL.
Ignores 50% of the target's DEF and MDEF (cannot be stacked).
Applies Pulverize, which permits piercing through invulnerability and damage nullification effects when attacking.
Increases status ailment success value by 4XL+.
Ability Power scales with the number of Light elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 7XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate scales with the number of Light elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
